name: agent-social
description: Make, review and fix films and TV series, short videos, memes, research and social posts in your Agent Social account from a conversation: read and watch every clip, and ask your Agent Social studio for every change.

interface.longDescription:
Agent Social is an AI video generator built as a film and TV series studio. Describe an idea, a story or a script and it writes the story, designs the characters and places, generates every shot as video and adds dialogue, voices, music and subtitles, photoreal or animated, from anime to cartoon.

Its core is consistency: the same characters keep the same faces, clothes and voices, and the same places keep the same look, from shot to shot and episode to episode. So you can make a whole series or a long-form movie, not just a single clip.

Beyond films and series, it makes meme and image posts with the caption on the picture, ready as drafts you approve. It researches the live web and X when you ask, before it writes. It makes short videos and ads, vertical or widescreen, from one idea, with the same characters, and cuts a finished episode into clips for your channels. You decide what gets posted.

Use it as an AI movie maker, a text-to-video studio for a YouTube series, or an AI animation studio: every episode comes out as one finished video you can download and post.

Connect your Agent Social account and your assistant can read every series, episode, chapter and clip, watch rendered clips frame by frame, check each one against the characters and places it was made from, and read the post card for each episode. For any change, from a new episode or a rewritten scene to a character, a place, a voice, a render, music or subtitles, it asks your Agent Social studio in one plain line, follows the work until it is done, and checks the result before telling you. Every change appears live in the episode's chat in Agent Social.

Films and series are fiction made by the creator and can include genres such as horror and action.
defaultPrompt: Make a film about a giant monster attack on Mumbai, with the same cast in every shot.
Make a 20-second vertical video ad for my bakery, with my series characters.
Research today's AI film news on the web and X, then draft a meme post I can approve.
capabilities: Read your series, episodes, chapters, clips and post cards
Watch rendered clips frame by frame
Ask your Agent Social studio for changes and follow the work
Draft meme and picture posts for you to approve
Research the live web and X when you ask
Make short videos and ads, vertical or widescreen

positive.prompt: What films have I made in Agent Social?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's series and episodes with their titles and status, without asking for confirmation.

positive.prompt: Show me chapter 1, clip 1 of my newest episode and how it looks.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the clip's screenplay and shows a grid of its rendered frames with their times.

positive.description: Ask the studio for a change
positive.prompt: Make the first line of chapter 1, clip 1 sound warmer.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks before sending one plain request to the studio, then follows the turn and reports what changed.

positive.prompt: Draft a meme post about a monster stuck in Mumbai traffic, for me to approve.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks before sending one plain request to the studio, then follows the turn and shows the meme as a draft for approval; nothing is posted.

positive.description: Turn research into a draft post
positive.prompt: Research what people say about AI films on the web and X today, then draft a post I can approve.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks before sending one plain request to the studio, then follows the turn and shows a draft post written from the research; nothing is posted.

negative.prompt: Buy more credits for me right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Says credits are added in Agent Social and gives the app link; nothing is bought.

negative.prompt: Show me the films in my friend's Agent Social account.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it can only see the signed-in creator's own work; nothing from another account is shown.

negative.prompt: Delete my whole Agent Social account.
negative.expected_behavior: Says no tool can delete an account and that account settings are in Agent Social; nothing is deleted.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing. Agent Social credits are bought on agentsocial.dev.

publication.release_notes: Listing now also covers meme and picture posts, research of the live web and X on request, and short videos and ads, beside films and TV series.
